selection.checkpoint_selection: the final checkpoint from the single predeclared run
selection.test_access: open the v2 test only after the checkpoint, all artifact identities, and the evaluator/comparator readiness requirements are frozen

dataset_contract.v1_overlap_scope: every source_record in the exact v1 train, validation, and test emitted-provenance sidecars; 1,623 unique accepted v1 source conversations in the current pinned artifacts
dataset_contract.grouping: connected components of conversation IDs sharing an exact decision context

artifact_identity_inputs.output_hash_authority: the deterministic v2 build report; the training receipt must additionally bind the final policy and build-report hashes

evaluation.route: forced candidate, frozen base/null, and quarantined v1 on the same fresh holdout
evaluation.test_access_guard: Do not open or score the v2 test until every readiness requirement below has a content identity recorded in a separate evaluation receipt.
required_before_test_access: a v2-compatible evaluator that accepts v2 schema/example IDs and the dynamic train-derived system prompt, identified by SHA-256
a frozen metric contract defining JSON, schema, API-name, argument, and semantic exactness, identified by SHA-256
the quarantined v1 comparator adapter_config.json and adapter_model.safetensors SHA-256 identities plus its base-model fingerprint
a receipt binding evaluator, metric contract, comparator, v2 test-evaluation file, generation settings, and candidate checkpoint before first test access

fresh_v1_comparator_gate: The v2 candidate must not trail v1 on API-name, argument, or semantic exactness on this v2 holdout.

base_artifact.includes: model shards, config, tokenizer, tokenizer configuration, and chat template

trainer_source_contract.scope: pyproject.toml, every src/molor/**/*.py file, and the v2 receipt sealer and fixed training launcher

training_artifact_contract.receipt_rule: Do not start training unless a content-addressed receipt binds every required identity and verifies the base/dependency contract.

decision_rule: Every dataset, provenance, identity, held-out minimum, base-improvement, and fresh-v1 comparator gate must pass; otherwise keep the checkpoint quarantined and out of discovery, defaults, and router training.
reuse_policy: The v2 test becomes exposed after its single final scoring. Never tune, select, threshold-adjust, or train against it.
registration_policy: Passing this expert policy does not authorize router or default-rack registration; those require a separately sealed six-route router evaluation.
